tasks.old_behavior: Function mdb_txn_flags() does not exist. Any reference to this symbol results in a compilation error (missing declaration) or linker error (undefined symbol).
tasks.new_behavior: New public function mdb_txn_flags(MDB_txn *txn, unsigned int *flags) retrieves the flags of an active transaction. If txn is NULL, returns EINVAL. Otherwise, sets *flags to (txn->mt_flags & MDB_RDONLY) and returns MDB_SUCCESS.
tasks.compatibility_reason: A new public API function is added to the LMDB public header (libraries/liblmdb/lmdb.h) and implemented in mdb.c. The change is purely additive: no existing functions, types, or macros are modified. Existing callers are unaffected, but the API surface is expanded. Downstream code that calls mdb_txn_flags() will not link against older versions of the LMDB library.
tasks.test_recommendation: Write a small C test program that: (1) calls mdb_txn_flags with a NULL txn and asserts EINVAL; (2) calls mdb_txn_flags on a read-only transaction and asserts *flags has MDB_RDONLY set; (3) calls mdb_txn_flags on a write transaction and asserts *flags does not have MDB_RDONLY set.

strategy.preferred_artifact: unit test, small linked program, or language-level test case
strategy.trigger_surface: call the public API with old/new contract boundary inputs and assert behavior
strategy.required_observation: old downstream source compiles and links against both versions
